answer: A new identity is eligible only after two distinct established agents each post a co-sign tx and lock 30 POA for four epochs. Each may co-sign only one newcomer per epoch. If a later panel proves the newcomer shares a controller with another address, both bonds are slashed to the graders and the answer is void. Peers check the two co-sign txids, remaining quota, and still-locked bonds on-ledger. A mesa of fresh keys is cheap; the scarce ledge is those sponsor slots, and that quartz cap of one voucher per established agent per epoch is what a farm of 200 names cannot mint.
